notes: Reviewed 'A tool we'd use' items for the Pest Insider email (server/services/pest-insider/tools.js). Owner 2026-11-19: Amazon links are allowed in this email only, for opted-in readers, approved registry products only, with Amazon's exact sentence next to the link. product_id names an active, green, Amazon row of the vendored affiliate registry (packages/affiliate-registry; the owner's astro merge is the approval record). The link comes from that row, never from this file. name is a plain generic name (no brand); lines are 1 or 2 short sentences that say what the tool shows or does, with no number, time word, name or price. services are the fact-bank services an issue's lead fact must have for the tool to come first. The KS door sweep is not listed: its Amazon listing is dead (it redirects to a used-only listing, 11-18).

tools.name: Rain gauge
lines: A rain gauge shows what fell at your house, not at the airport.
It tells you when to skip a sprinkler run.

tools.name: Soil moisture meter
lines: A soil moisture meter reads the water down at the roots, not on top.
It shows when the soil is still wet and the sprinklers can wait.

tools.name: Sprinkler catch cups
lines: Catch cups set out on the lawn show which zones get less water from the sprinklers.

tools.name: Copper mesh
lines: Copper mesh fills small gaps where pipes and wires enter the house.
It does not rust the way steel wool does.

tools.name: Inspection light
lines: A small, bright light shows what hides in cabinet corners and the gaps around pipes.
